payload.title: delivery_closure still decides that a request's PR merged from ci/merge-outcomes.jsonl, own_pr_ci's post-merge ledger, instead of merge_record, and F3.4 narrowed that ledger to PRs merge_record holds as ARIA's inside a 20-PR window, so a merged PR can stay in its last pre-merge state in the delivery closure
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/delivery_closure.py:123-137 (a PR is merged only when a merge outcome row exists, else the last CI check state decides)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/delivery_closure.py:252-256 (latest_merge is read from the merge-outcomes ledger)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/delivery_closure.py:268-270 (merge_status is set only from a merge-outcome row with a merge_sha)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/own_pr_ci.py:206-211 (merge-outcome rows now exist only for PRs in arias_merges)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/merge_record.py:358-364 (the stated rule: which merges happened is read in merge_record and nowhere else)
aria-kernel/tests/invariants/test_merge_index_single_owner.py:152-181 (the pin does not look at this reader)
payload.rule_violated: F3.3a one-owner rule (merge_record.py:358-364): 'which merges happened, and which are ARIA's' is read in merge_record and nowhere else.
payload.notes: A request's PR is merged by a person and merge_record has not classified its head as ARIA's, or the PR left the 20-PR scan window, so no merge-outcome row exists. delivery_closure keeps the state of the last own-PR check (ci_pending or ci_red) and rec.delivered stays false for a change that is on main, which feeds the verified_prs gap of the delivery SLO. The narrowing came from F3.4's arias_merges gate; the invariant that should have caught the second reader does not scan this shape. Close condition: Derive a request PR's merged state from merge_record (fold_merged_rows or arias_merges by pr_number) and keep own_pr_ci's ledger for the post-merge CI verdict only; extend the single-owner invariant with this reader's shape and add a closure test with a merged row and no merge-outcome row expecting 'merged'. Verified at origin/main ae2958653d.
